title: A create's seed names what the CMS stamps on the record itself, on WordPress and Joomla
steps: Run the live-push-changeset cases: a new page, picture and menu item; a new template part, synced pattern and Additional CSS; a new Joomla article and redirect.
expect: WordPress posts: guid, post_author, post_date_gmt, post_modified, post_modified_gmt; the other kinds the four times, guid and post_author, a menu item also post_name; Joomla article the times and author columns; redirect created_date and modified_date.
evidence: Issue #223 re-test; measured on two real WordPress 7.1 sites through the Claude Cowork writer

cmd: --test-name-pattern=#223|each waits for what it names|new article in a new category
tests: WordPress: a new page with a new picture, a new category and a menu entry
WordPress: a new template part, Additional CSS and synced pattern name what WordPress stamps on them
Joomla: a new redirect names the dates Joomla stamps on it
Joomla: a new article in a new category is two creates
